name: Serramazzoni (Italy)
description: Light blue field with a yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Serramazzoni (a red tower on white above a green mount) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Serramazzoni, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Serramazzoni arms — red tower on white above a green mount, crowned, within branches
